BiblicalUsage: Hazerim is named once, as the villages where the Avims dwelt as far as Azzah, until the Caphtorims destroyed them and dwelt in their place. It is a place remembered only by who lived there and who took it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God records the peoples who came and went before Israel, because the land's story did not start with us. Hazerim belongs to the Avims and the Caphtorims before it belongs to anyone else.
RelatedEvents: The Defeat of Sihon and Og
